create_jsonl_dataset: create a JsonlDataset instance from a JSONL file with a tokenizer, transforms, vocab, and args
load_jsonl_data: load JSONL data line by line into a PyTorch Dataset for multimodal training
get_dataset_item: get a sentence, segment, image, and label tuple from the dataset by index
tokenize_vsnli_sentences: tokenize and truncate two sentences for the VSNLI task with segment IDs
apply_image_dropout: randomly drop images during dataset initialization based on a configurable dropout percentage
